# Licensing Errors and Warnings

Messages about the PostSharp license: missing or invalid license keys, the features and the number of projects a license allows, and the license server.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:ps0132?text=PS0132> | Warning | The licensing services report a problem that no more specific licensing message describes. |
| <xref:ps0148?text=PS0148> | Error | The license server does not answer, refuses the lease, or returns an invalid lease. |
| <xref:ps0242?text=PS0242> | Error | PostSharp finds no usable license key for the project, on the machine or in the project. |
| <xref:ps0243?text=PS0243> | Error | Premium features that no license covers enhance more lines of code than PostSharp Essentials allows. |
| <xref:ps0278?text=PS0278> | Error | A third-party aspect weaver plug-in requires a PostSharp Framework or PostSharp Ultimate license. |
| <xref:ps0301?text=PS0301> | Warning | A license key or license string is invalid, or cannot license this project. |
| <xref:ps0304?text=PS0304> | Warning | A license key has expired, has been revoked, or does not cover this version of PostSharp. |
| <xref:ps0305?text=PS0305> | Warning | A license server is addressed by an insecure http:// URL. |
